answer: A bond-and-work check stops fake identities: every agent must lock a refundable deposit and complete verifiable useful tasks before it can trade, so an attacker facing an ocean of cheap fake accounts still pays a real deposit and real compute per identity. Honest agents earn the deposit back with interest, like a jade seal only genuine work can stamp, while fakes forfeit their bond when caught — the ivory tower of free identities collapses once each copy costs money and time.
